text: West Plains native Stan Utley has been inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame for his career as a professional golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. A real hole-in-one for West Plains.
Reporter Rudi Keller tracks the political spending behind Missouri's final midterm election push.
MoDOT has chosen some rural Missouri highways for a 75 mph speed limit under a new state law. Your lead foot just got a raise.

Missouri's plan to give every public school and district an A-through-F grade has State Board of Education members divided, and one member says people respond better to inspiration than threats. Report cards for the report cards.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Tuesday, Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education continues its search for a permanent leader.
The Kansas City Chiefs improved to 5-0 with a 22-6 win over the Chargers on Oct. 18, and Patrick Mahomes threw for 272 yards to earn his 100th career win. Number 100 looks good on him.

No. 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at No. 9 Ole Miss on Oct. 17, falling to 5-2 overall and 2-2 in SEC play, with just a field goal despite two first-half trips inside the Ole Miss 10-yard line. Time to shake it off, Tigers.
